draft_en.subject: Industrial switch from ISAF - 8 PoE+ + 2 SFP for field cabinets
draft_en.body:
Hi Hasti,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

The industrial switch you asked about: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, -40 to 75 C, unmanaged, model STI-288GP - $59.8 USD EXW; the L2 managed version STI-288GPM is $82.2 (MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS). For the equipment room side, the 8 x PoE+ + 2 SFP L2+ rack/desktop unit STC-28DGGPM is $84.1.

One question: in your IP camera projects, how many cameras hang off one field cabinet - is 8 ports enough?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
